description: The dangerous_function rule: an always-on denylist of builtins that reach data outside their arguments (dynamic SQL and XML export, files, large objects, dblink, session settings, rowtype dereference, setval, admin). Matched on the bare name, case-folded, at any depth and in any clause, whatever the table policy; ordinary analytics, user functions, nextval and the *_to_record family stay allowed. Converted from the old engine's dangerous-function corpus plus quoting, escape and clause-position variants.
